Could be that HDD is failing and causing programs to lag.

Cab't repair it, just replace it. If it has windows XP its probably an old hunk of a 5200 RPM HDD. You can buy either an Solid State Drive (SSD) or a 7200 RPM HDD. You will get some more storage out of the HDD option for the money but if it is Windows XP, you won't need a lot of storage so a cheap 20 dollar Kingston 128 GB SSD will work. Then you transfer the HDD contents over before it fails or you will have to reinstall XP.
